data.plain_english: A well-known investor said rising prices might push the US central bank to raise interest rates this month. Higher rates tend to hurt banks and property companies in America, and they put pressure on Chinese technology firms. American technology is the council's biggest disagreement: it has risen strongly, but it could be vulnerable if rates keep climbing. In China, government support may help, but it is unclear how much it will really change. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell anything.
